lines.en: label springtime15:
scene amisspecialxmasparty1
It sings in its sleep.
lines.zh: 它在睡梦中歌唱。

lines.en: Not the mouth on the head of the body with the arms that hold the world up, but the inarguable distance between the four points of focus on an uncapitalized letter T.
lines.zh: 不是那具用双臂撑起世界的身体、头上那张嘴，而是一个没有大写的字母 T 上四个焦点之间那段无可争辩的距离。

lines.en: The melody is like milk — white, but entirely impure.
lines.zh: 那旋律像牛奶——洁白，却完全不纯。

lines.en: Delicious, yet difficult to digest after going long periods of time without a sip or two.
lines.zh: 美味，却在长时间没喝上一两口之后难以消化。

lines.en: It coats your tongue as you drink it down and you revel in the sensation of its makeshift mucosal barrier protecting you from tasting the roof of your mouth.
lines.zh: 你咽下它时，它会覆上你的舌头，而你沉醉于那层临时黏液屏障的触感——它让你尝不到自己的上颚。

lines.en: When you were younger, when the ring still wrapped around your limbs, this would be the type of thought you would focus on.
lines.zh: 在你更小的时候，在那个圆环还缠着你四肢的时候，你会专注的就是这类念头。

lines.en: On those long nights where the position of the moon would hurt your eyes as you tried to sleep, there was naught to do but pay homage to the little things.
lines.zh: 在那些你想要入睡、月亮的位置却刺痛你眼睛的漫长夜晚里，除了向那些微小的事物致敬，别无他事可做。

lines.en: If you did it enough times — if you acknowledged every speck of matter in the room, you’d consider yourself protected from the light that kept you up.
lines.zh: 如果做得够多次——如果你承认了房间里每一粒物质，你就会认为自己已被那道让你无法入睡的光所豁免。

lines.en: You’d consider yourself thankful enough to make it through this half-dark descent without so much as a divine scratch — for a scratch from a higher power would burn you from the inside out.
lines.zh: 你会认为自己足够感恩，能安然走完这段半明半暗的坠落，连一道神圣的划痕都不会有——因为来自更高存在的划痕会由内而外把你烧尽。

lines.en: And you didn’t want that.
lines.zh: 而你不想要那样。

lines.en: And {i}because{/i} you didn’t want that, those little things were torturous. Yet you couldn’t resist focusing on them because that’s what you {i}always{/i} did.
lines.zh: 而{i}正因为你{/i}不想要那样，那些微小的事物成了折磨。可你又忍不住去专注它们，因为你{i}向来{/i}如此。

lines.en: You focused on things.
lines.zh: 你专注于事物。

lines.en: Those mittens hanging from that hook you hit your head on once.
lines.zh: 那副挂在钩子上的连指手套——你曾在那个钩子上撞过头。

lines.en: That picture of a cow jumping over the moon in the corner of the room and that mouse in this house that still felt like a tomb.
lines.zh: 房间角落里那幅母牛跳过月亮的画，还有这栋仍然像坟墓的房子里那只老鼠。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 但为什么呢？

lines.en: Why did it feel that way?
lines.zh: 为什么会有那种感觉？

lines.en: This was before the world died off.
lines.zh: 那是在世界死绝之前。

lines.en: This was {i}before{/i} you knew what love was. {i}Before{/i} you felt the sting of accidental abandonment and {i}before{/i} the only thing that mattered to you was avoiding those mittens and mice.
lines.zh: 那是{i}在{/i}你懂得爱之前。{i}在{/i}你尝到意外被遗弃的刺痛之前，也{i}在{/i}你唯一在乎的事变成避开那些手套和老鼠之前。

lines.en: You were too young to know something was wrong yet.
lines.zh: 你还太小，还不知道有什么不对劲。

lines.en: scene black
But I watched you.
lines.zh: 可我一直看着你。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty2
I have always been that which lurks in the shadows — telling you to hush and submit to the all-seeing eye of the night.
lines.zh: 我一向就是那个潜伏在阴影里的东西——叫你安静，向夜晚那只全视之眼臣服。

lines.en: The creaking of my chair would be the only lullaby you’d need. And it would distract you from the sickening sounds of your growing inner monologue.
lines.zh: 我椅子的吱呀声，就是唯一你需要的摇篮曲。而它会分散你的注意力，让你听不见内心独白越来越令人作呕的声音。

lines.en: Goodnight, you. Goodnight, moon.
lines.zh: 晚安，你。晚安，月亮。

lines.en: Goodnight everything everywhere, everyone too.
lines.zh: 晚安，各处的一切，也晚安，所有人。

lines.en: But you never slept.
lines.zh: 可你从来没有睡着过。

lines.en: You never slept.
lines.zh: 你从来没有睡着过。

lines.en: Why didn’t you ever sleep?
lines.zh: 你为什么从来都睡不着？

lines.en: Why wasn’t my company good enough for you?
lines.zh: 为什么我的陪伴对你来说还不够好？

lines.en: Why didn’t security make you feel secure? And why did that all-seeing eye so often overlook {i}you?{/i} Why YOU? What made {b}YOU{/b} special? Why was it always {size=+15}YOU?{/size}
lines.zh: 为什么安全感没能让你感到安全？为什么那只全视之眼总是偏偏漏掉{i}你{/i}？为什么是你？{b}你{/b}有什么特别的？为什么总是{size=+15}你{/size}？

lines.en: At first, I couldn’t tell. But it became clearer as the days went by.
lines.zh: 一开始我说不上来。但随着日子一天天过去，它变得越来越清晰。

lines.en: And every time you’d stare at those mittens, I’d get a step closer to realizing something that separated the two of us. Something {i}more{/i} than a carpet and cats.
lines.zh: 而每一次你盯着那副连指手套看，我就离意识到某样把我们分开的东西更近一步。某样{i}比{/i}地毯和猫更多的东西。

lines.en: It’s that I was big...and you were small.
lines.zh: 那就是：我很大……而你还小。

lines.en: Even now, you’re small. And you’re so caught up in your routines and tendencies that I could abandon you altogether and nothing would change.
lines.zh: 即便是现在，你也还是小。而你深陷在自己的习惯和惯性里，就算我彻底抛弃你，什么都不会改变。

lines.en: You’d still neglect to neglect all matter and space.
lines.zh: 你依然会「疏于」去「疏离」所有的物质与空间。

lines.en: Your eyes would still shut every time you heard the door open — begging for a miracle, but finding a ghost.
lines.zh: 每次听到门开，你的眼睛依然会闭上——祈求一个奇迹，却只找到一个幽灵。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty3
You used to believe in God. But I imagine it’s just because you were asked to.
lines.zh: 你曾经信仰上帝。不过我想，那只是因为有人要你信。

lines.en: Sometimes, another woman would enter the room and get into the bed with you.
lines.zh: 有时候，会有另一个女人走进房间，爬上床和你躺在一起。

lines.en: She’d hold you close and cry into your shoulder, screaming at the top of her lungs about how you smelled like {i}him.{/i} But who {i}was{/i} he anyway? And why did she miss him so much?
lines.zh: 她会紧紧抱着你，把眼泪洒在你肩上，扯着嗓子喊你身上有{i}他{/i}的味道。可{i}他{/i}到底是谁呢？她为什么这么想念他？

lines.en: She’d fall asleep beside you. You never knew what to do with your hands. And in those moments, you would always revert to something that made you feel comfortable.
lines.zh: 她会在你身边睡着。你从来不知道自己的手该往哪儿放。而在那些时刻，你总会退回某样让你感到舒服的东西上。

lines.en: Or at least as close to comfort as you could get without wincing.
lines.zh: 或者至少是你在不皱眉的前提下能得到的、最接近舒服的状态。

lines.en: Goodnight, clocks. Goodnight, socks.
lines.zh: 晚安，时钟。晚安，袜子。

lines.en: Goodnight Jesus and Mary and Joseph and Josh.
lines.zh: 晚安，Jesus、Mary、Joseph，还有 Josh。

lines.en: But most importantly — goodnight to the figure in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: 但最重要的是——晚安，房间角落里的那个身影。

lines.en: The one who was always watching over you.
lines.zh: 那个一直守望着你的人。

lines.en: We never spoke directly, but I could always tell you knew I was there.
lines.zh: 我们从未直接说过话，可我总能看出你知道我在那儿。

lines.en: scene black
And maybe that’s why I still watch you.
lines.zh: 也许这就是为什么我至今仍在看着你。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty1
: “Jim, dear,” she cried, “don’t look at me like that. I had my hair cut off and sold it. I couldn’t live through Christmas without giving you a gift.”
lines.zh: : 「Jim，亲爱的，」她喊道，「别那样看着我。我把头发剪掉卖了。我没办法不送你礼物就熬过这个圣诞节。」

lines.en: : “My hair will grow again. You won’t care, will you? My hair grows very fast. It’s Christmas, Jim. Let’s be happy. You don’t know what a nice—what a beautiful nice gift I got for you.”
lines.zh: : 「我的头发还会长回来的。你不会在意的，对吧？我的头发长得很快。这是圣诞节，Jim。让我们开心点吧。你不知道我给你买了多好的——多漂亮、多好的一件礼物。」

lines.en: : “You’ve cut off your hair?” asked Jim slowly. He seemed to labor to understand what had happened. He seemed not to feel sure he knew.
lines.zh: : 「你把头发剪掉了？」Jim 慢慢地问。他似乎费了很大力气才弄明白发生了什么。他似乎并不确定自己真的知道。

lines.en: : “Cut it off and sold it,” said Della. “Don’t you like me now? I’m me, Jim. I’m the same without my hair.”
lines.zh: : 「剪掉卖了，」Della 说。「你现在不喜欢我了吗？我还是我啊，Jim。没有头发我也还是我。」

lines.en: : Jim looked around the room. “You say your hair is gone?” he said.
lines.zh: : Jim 环顾了一下房间。「你是说你的头发没了？」他说。

lines.en: : “You don’t have to look for it,” said Della. “It’s sold, I tell you— sold and gone, too. It’s the night before Christmas, boy. Be good to me, because I sold it for you.”
lines.zh: : 「你不用找它了，」Della 说。「它被卖掉了，我告诉你——卖了，也没了。这是平安夜，小子。对我好一点吧，因为我是为你才卖掉它的。」

lines.en: : “Maybe the hairs of my head could be counted,” she said, “but no one could ever count my love for you. Shall we eat dinner, Jim?”
lines.zh: : 「也许我头上的头发数得清，」她说，「但没有人能数清我对你的爱。我们吃晚饭好吗，Jim？」

lines.en: : Jim put his arms around his Della. “For ten seconds let us look in another direction. Eight dollars a week or a million dollars a year— how different are they?”
lines.zh: : Jim 张开双臂抱住他的 Della。「让我们用十秒钟把目光投向别处。一周八美元也好，一年一百万美元也好——它们能有多大差别？」

lines.en: : Someone may give you an answer, but it will be wrong. The magi brought valuable gifts, but that was not among them. My meaning will be explained soon.
lines.zh: : 也许有人会给你一个答案，但那会是错的。东方三博士带来过珍贵的礼物，但那不在其中。我的意思很快就会说明。

lines.en: : From inside the coat, Jim took something tied in paper. He threw it upon the table. “I want you to understand me, Dell,” he said. “Nothing like a haircut could make me love you any less.”
lines.zh: : Jim 从外套里掏出一个用纸包着的东西。他把它扔在桌上。「我想让你明白我，Dell，」他说。「什么样的发型都不会让我对你的爱减少分毫。」

lines.en: : “But if you’ll open that, you may know what I felt when I came in.” White fingers pulled off the paper. And then a cry of joy; and then a change to tears.
lines.zh: : 「不过如果你打开它，你就会知道我进门时的感受。」白皙的手指拆开了纸。接着是一声欢呼；接着又化作了眼泪。

lines.en: : For there lay The Combs—the combs that Della had seen in a shop window and loved for a long time. Beautiful combs, with jewels, perfect for her beautiful hair.
lines.zh: : 因为那里躺着那套梳子——就是 Della 在商店橱窗里见过、喜欢了很久的那套梳子。镶嵌着珠宝的漂亮梳子，配她那美丽的头发再合适不过。

lines.en: : She had looked at them without the least hope of owning them. And now they were hers, but her hair was gone.
lines.zh: : 她曾经看着它们，丝毫没有拥有的指望。现在它们属于她了，可她的头发已经不在了。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty4
: But she held them to her heart, and at last was able to look up and say: “My hair grows so fast, Jim!”
lines.zh: : 可她把它们贴在胸口，终于抬起头说：「我的头发长得很快的，Jim！」

lines.en: : Wasn’t that such a pretty story, Sensei? Two people who love each other so much that they gave away the things that were most important to them just to help {i}each other?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这是个很美的故事吧，Sensei？两个深爱彼此的人，为了{i}彼此{/i}而把自己最重要的东西都送了出去？

lines.en: : Some people say that love is all about sacrifices, you know. And I think I agree! I mean, just look at everything I’ve sacrificed for you.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，有人说爱就是关于牺牲。我想我同意！我是说，看看我为你牺牲了多少东西吧。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty5
: Doesn’t that make you happy? Aren’t you glad to know I cherish you so much that I’m willing to let my grades slip to take care of you? Which isn’t to say they’ve ever been good, but still.
lines.zh: : 这难道不让你开心吗？知道我这么珍视你，甚至愿意让成绩下滑也要照顾你，你难道不高兴吗？不过我也不是说我的成绩曾经好过，但还是嘛。

lines.en: : Oh, and don’t worry about me missing all that work at the maid cafe either. You’re still getting checks from school and I’ve been using them to take care of all the bills so the water can stay on.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，我错过女仆咖啡厅那么多班的事你也别担心。学校那边还是会给你寄支票，而我一直在用它们付清所有账单，好让水还能用。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty6
: We wouldn’t want this to be like Grandma’s house, would we? Like, could you {i}imagine{/i} having to collect water from the lake just to take a bath? That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: : 我们可不希望这里变得像外婆家那样，对吧？比如说，你能{i}想象{/i}为了洗个澡还得去湖里打水吗？那听起来太可怕了。

lines.en: : I’m just glad our house is so safe, you know? Especially with all the extra stuff I’ve done to make sure nobody can hurt you in here. But it’s not like we’ll need that forever!
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴我们家这么安全，你知道吗？尤其是我还额外做了那么多，确保没有人能在这里伤到你。不过我们也不需要永远那样！

lines.en: : Once you’re all better, we can take down the locks and you can go back to being a teacher like you’ve always wanted!
lines.zh: : 等你完全好了，我们就可以把锁拆掉，你也可以回去当老师，就像你一直想要的那样！

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty7
: {i}Only{/i} when you’re better, though. Which means being strong enough to keep other people from taking advantage of you all the time. Got it, mister?
lines.zh: : 不过{i}只有{/i}等你好了才行。也就是说，你得强壮到能不让别人一直占你便宜。明白了吗，先生？

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. You’re doing a {i}great{/i} job, [amimaster]! I mean that! And you’re the only person I’d never ever lie to.
lines.zh: : 才不是。你做得{i}很棒{/i}，[amimaster]！我是真心的！而且你是我唯一永远不会说谎的人。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty8
: It hurts a little, you know. Having to be the bad guy, I mean. It’d be {i}great{/i} to let everybody back into the house again. It’d be {i}great{/i} being able to go to the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 这有点伤人，你知道吗。我是说，不得不当那个坏人。要是能让大家重新进屋来，那该{i}多好{/i}。要是能去圣诞派对，那也该{i}多好{/i}。

lines.en: : It just isn’t safe anymore. Too many people are trying to take advantage of you. And since I’m your wonderful, loving, amazing, beautiful, gorgeous niece, I refuse to let that happen.
lines.zh: : 只是现在不安全了。太多人想占你便宜了。而我既然是你那体贴、可爱、了不起、美丽、耀眼的侄女，我就绝不会让那种事发生。

lines.en: : But maybe once people can gain my trust back, I’ll let them in. Like Ayane, for example! She’s been coming here so often that I’m starting to think she might actually want to help you.
lines.zh: : 不过也许等大家重新赢得我的信任，我就会放她们进来。比如说 Ayane！她来得那么勤，我都开始觉得她可能真的想帮你了。

lines.en: : Visits would be supervised, of course. She {i}has{/i} had a crush on you for a long time, but I think she’s close to understanding her place now and won’t try anything stupid.
lines.zh: : 探视当然是要在监督下进行的。她{i}确实{/i}暗恋你很久了，不过我觉得她差不多已经明白自己的位置，不会再做蠢事了。

lines.en: : And if she does, I’ll just have to make sure she’s never able to again. But how would I do that, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 如果她敢，我就得确保她永远都没机会再犯。不过我该怎么做呢，我很好奇？

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty9
: Do you have any ideas, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你有什么主意吗，Sensei？

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty10
: Ah! Sensei! I’m happy you’re so dedicated to me, but surely you don’t think we’d have to do something {i}that{/i} serious, do you? I mean...we’ve known Ayane forever. I love her!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！我很高兴你这么为我着想，可你总不至于觉得我们非得做到{i}那么{/i}绝吧？我是说……我们认识 Ayane 都多久了。我爱她！

lines.en: : No, of course I don’t love her as much as I love you. I’m just saying that-
lines.zh: : 不，我当然没有爱你那么爱她。我只是说——

lines.en: : I mean...that {i}is{/i} a good point.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这{i}确实{/i}是个好观点。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty11
: Plus, for all we know, she might just be {i}pretending{/i} to be on our side because she thinks I’m gullible. But I’m not gullible at all. I’m way smarter than anybody gives me credit for.
lines.zh: : 再说，说不定她只是在{i}假装{/i}站在我们这边，因为她觉得我好骗。可我一点都不好骗。我比任何人以为的都要聪明得多。

lines.en: : Like, just look at what I was able to do with the windows. Not everyone could learn how to install bars after just watching a couple Youtube videos, you know?
lines.zh: : 比如说，看看我在窗户上做了什么。不是谁都能光看几个 Youtube 视频就学会装防盗栏的，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...{i}yeah.{/i} Now that you mention it, she {i}has{/i} seemed a little different lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}是啊{/i}。你这么一说，她最近{i}确实{/i}看起来有点不一样。

lines.en: : I’m glad at least [[redacted] is back to normal, though. She was really starting to get on my nerves.
lines.zh: : 不过至少 [[redacted] 恢复正常了，我很高兴。她之前真是越来越让我烦了。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty12
: Oh, I know. I won’t let her anywhere close, don’t worry. I know how horrible she makes you feel. And my top priority will always be keeping you safe. Okay?
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。我不会让她靠近的，别担心。我知道她让你有多难受。而我的首要任务永远是保证你的安全。好吗？

lines.en: : I love [[redacted]. Girls like her can’t be trusted, though. Especially around awesome and attractive guys like you.
lines.zh: : 我爱 [[redacted]。不过像她那样的女孩不能信。尤其是在像你这么棒、这么有魅力的男人身边。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty13
: Like, did you know I caught her having sex at the shrine once?
lines.zh: : 比如说，你知道我有一次撞见她在神社做爱吗？

lines.en: : She denies it was her, of course. And it’s not like I tried to open the door because {i}ew.{/i} But I know [[redacted]’s voice when I hear it. And {i}boy,{/i} did I hear it.
lines.zh: : 她当然否认那是她。而且我也没有试图去推开门，因为{i}恶心死了{/i}。可我一听就知道那是 [[redacted] 的声音。而{i}天哪{/i}，我确实听到了。

lines.en: : I know! Like, have some decency. Not only are you supposed to be working, but the shrines are where the gods reside. And doing anything to make a {i}god{/i} angry is a total death sentence.
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！拜托有点分寸。先不说你本该在工作，神社可是神灵居住的地方。做任何惹怒{i}神明{/i}的事都等同于判死刑。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty14
: But yeah, even {i}I{/i} don’t trust her completely. I mean, why would I when she’s so obviously playing at something?
lines.zh: : 不过是啊，连{i}我{/i}都不完全信任她。我是说，她明显在耍什么花招，我凭什么信她？

lines.en: : She’s probably like everybody else at the end of the day — trying to get closer to you so she can fulfill her crazy, perverted fantasies. She’ll never actually {i}love{/i} you, though.
lines.zh: : 到头来她大概跟其他人一样——想方设法靠近你，好实现她那些疯狂、变态的幻想。不过她永远不会真的{i}爱{/i}你。

lines.en: : Nobody will. Which isn’t to say there’s something wrong with you, of course. You’re perfect.
lines.zh: : 谁都不会。当然，这并不代表你有什么问题。你是完美的。

lines.en: : But there are parts of you I know you’ll never share with anyone else. And you can’t love someone romantically if you only know {i}half{/i} of their story, right?
lines.zh: : 可你身上有些部分，我知道你永远不会跟别人分享。而如果你只知道一个人的{i}一半{/i}故事，你就不可能爱上她，对吧？

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty15
: Really? You don’t know {i}anything{/i} about her?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你对她{i}一点{/i}都不了解？

lines.en: : Then, that’s probably why she makes you so uncomfortable. But like I said, you don’t have to worry about [[redacted]. I can’t imagine she’ll be bothering you so long as you’re here.
lines.zh: : 那大概就是她让你这么不自在的原因了。不过就像我说的，你不用担心 [[redacted]。我想只要你在这儿，她就不会来烦你。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty10

: Well, why didn’t you just say so?! It’s not like I’m {i}trying{/i} to kill the Christmas mood. I just thought you were getting bored of all your old books since I’ve been reading them to you all night.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不早说？！我又{i}不是故意{/i}要扫圣诞的兴。我只是以为，我一整晚都在念那些旧书给你听，你大概已经听腻了。

lines.en: : One of {i}my{/i} poems? Are you sure? There are like, a zillion people who are better than me when it comes to that stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}写的诗？你确定吗？在那方面比我强的人大概有一百万个吧。

lines.en: : Jeez! You too?
lines.zh: : 天哪！连你也这样？

lines.en: : I swear, it’s like {i}everybody’s{/i} been on my case since I won that contest thingy. You’re all blowing this way out of proportion.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，自从我赢了那个什么比赛，就{i}所有人{/i}都盯着我。你们全都在小题大做。

lines.en: : Oh, not at all! It gets on my nerves when {i}they{/i} bug me about it, but I could never be annoyed with you, Sensei. Of course I’ll read you a poem.
lines.zh: : 哦，完全不会！{i}她们{/i}来烦我的时候我确实会不爽，可我永远不可能对你生气，Sensei。我当然会给你念首诗。

lines.en: : I just can’t guarantee you’ll enjoy it since it’s the first time I’ve ever made one with, like...a Christmas theme to it.
lines.zh: : 我只是不能保证你会喜欢，因为这是我第一次写，呃……圣诞主题的。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty16
: Yeah. Just don’t be {i}too{/i} harsh on me if it’s not good.
lines.zh: : 好吧。要是不好的话，别对我{i}太{/i}苛刻就行。

lines.en: : I break easily, you know.
lines.zh: : 我很容易碎的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : It’s the 25th at 2:00 AM — I just heard Santa leave.
lines.zh: : 现在是 25 号凌晨两点——我刚听到圣诞老人离开。

lines.en: : I can’t wait to see my gifts this year. I’ve been up since Christmas Eve.
lines.zh: : 我等不及想看今年的礼物了。我从平安夜起就一直没睡。

lines.en: : Mom says to stay put in my room — Dad says I must be good.
lines.zh: : 妈妈说让我待在房间里别动——爸爸说我要乖。

lines.en: : But good girls get excited too. I wish they understood-
lines.zh: : 可乖女孩也会兴奋啊。我真希望他们能明白——

lines.en: : How badly that I want those gifts. How wondrous they must be-
lines.zh: : 我有多想要那些礼物。它们一定有多奇妙——

lines.en: : I didn’t even make a list this year. Santa, what’s in store for me?
lines.zh: : 我今年连清单都没列。圣诞老人，给我准备了什么呢？

lines.en: : A pony or a peony? A dollhouse or a doll?
lines.zh: : 是小马还是牡丹？是玩具屋还是洋娃娃？

lines.en: : Maybe Santa gave me all of them? Maybe Rudolph’s in the hall?
lines.zh: : 也许圣诞老人全都给我了？也许 Rudolph 就在走廊里？

lines.en: : I can’t help but break the rules this time. I’m so gleeful, I can’t wait.
lines.zh: : 这一次我忍不住要打破规矩了。我太开心了，等不及了。

lines.en: : So I throw open my bedroom door! Sprint down the stairs, but...
lines.zh: : 于是我推开卧室的门！冲下楼梯，可是……

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty17
: It’s too late.
lines.zh: : 太迟了。

lines.en: : There’s nothing near the Christmas tree, but that fat man drank the milk.
lines.zh: : 圣诞树旁什么都没有，可那个胖男人把牛奶喝了。

lines.en: : He ate my homemade cookies and spilled crumbs across the Christmas silk.
lines.zh: : 他吃光了我亲手做的饼干，还把碎屑撒了一圣诞节的丝绸。

lines.en: : Now I’m grounded and in trouble. Mom is angry, Dad is pissed.
lines.zh: : 现在我受罚了，惹上麻烦了。妈妈很生气，爸爸气炸了。

lines.en: : And I can’t help but sit and wonder what would happen if I made a list.
lines.zh: : 而我忍不住坐着想，如果我列了清单会怎么样。

lines.en: : If I turned the cuckoo backward, would it cry again at midnight?
lines.zh: : 如果我把布谷钟倒着拨，它会在午夜再叫一次吗？

lines.en: : Would Santa break into our home? Should I turn back on the light?
lines.zh: : 圣诞老人会闯进我们家吗？我要不要把灯重新打开？

lines.en: : I’m a good girl every other day. It’s just one rule I defied.
lines.zh: : 除了这一天，我每天都乖。我只是犯了一条规矩。

lines.en: : So why should {i}I{/i} be punished while the bad girls play outside?
lines.zh: : 那么为什么坏女孩在外面玩，而受罚的却是{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : With their peonies and ponies. Their dollhouses and dolls.
lines.zh: : 带着她们的牡丹和小马。她们的玩具屋和洋娃娃。

lines.en: : I watch them from my window. Footsteps echo down the hall-
lines.zh: : 我从窗口望着她们。脚步声在走廊里回荡——

lines.en: : I think it’s Santa here again. No, I think it might be God.
lines.zh: : 我以为圣诞老人又来了。不，我想那也许是上帝。

lines.en: : He mocks me from behind the door, but I see through his facade.
lines.zh: : 他在门后嘲笑我，可我看穿了他的伪装。

lines.en: : As it turns out, Santa isn’t real. I’ve accepted nothing is.
lines.zh: : 结果发现，圣诞老人并不存在。我已经接受了什么都不存在。

lines.en: : That some girls just draw the short straw due to helplessness or haplessness.
lines.zh: : 有些女孩只是因为无助或不幸，抽到了最短的那根签。

lines.en: : I’m giving up on Christmas. I’m giving up on fate.
lines.zh: : 我要放弃圣诞节了。我要放弃命运了。

lines.en: : Starting now, I’ll make my own gifts. Starting now, I’ll...
lines.zh: : 从现在起，我要自己给自己做礼物。从现在起，我要……

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty18
: Oh. I forgot to come up with a rhyme for the last line.
lines.zh: : 哦。我忘了给最后一行想个韵。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty19
: Oh well! That was pretty long anyway, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 算了！反正也挺长的，不是吗？

lines.en: : It’s no “Visit from St. Nicholas,” but I think it’s pretty okay for the most part.
lines.zh: : 它比不上《圣尼古拉来访》，不过我觉得大体上还算不错。

lines.en: : How did {i}you{/i} feel about it, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得怎么样，Sensei？

lines.en: : No, I don’t think it’s sad at all! In fact, I think it’s pretty hopeful. You see, sometimes, we can’t always get what we want even if we deserve it. So-
lines.zh: : 不，我一点都不觉得它悲伤！事实上，我觉得它充满希望。你看，有时候，就算我们配得上，也未必能得到想要的。所以——

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty20
: Heheh! Were you not paying attention? I literally {i}just{/i} said we can’t always get what we want. Even {i}if{/i} we deserve it.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！你没在听吗？我{i}刚刚{/i}才说了，我们未必总能得到想要的。{i}就算{/i}我们配得上。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty21
: Oh yeah? Are my cookies not good enough for you? You really {i}need{/i} a Christmas cake?
lines.zh: : 是吗？我的饼干还不够好吗？你真的{i}非要{/i}一个圣诞蛋糕？

lines.en: : [amimaster], do you have any idea what time it is right now? All the shops around here close early on Christmas. I’d have to walk like five miles to find a cake.
lines.zh: : [amimaster]，你知道现在几点了吗？圣诞节这天附近所有店都很早关门。我得走大概五英里才能找到蛋糕。

lines.en: : Maybe I can bake you one instead? We don’t have enough eggs right now, but I could run to the convenience store really quick if you don’t mind waiting for me. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 也许我可以给你烤一个？我们现在鸡蛋不够，不过如果你不介意等我，我可以飞快跑去一趟便利店。这样行吗？

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty22
: Yes, I can get you chicken too. I’m sorry for not thinking to pick some up earlier. I have failed you as a niece.
lines.zh: : 好的，我也可以给你买炸鸡。抱歉我早没想到买一些。作为侄女，我让你失望了。

lines.en: scene amisspecialxmasparty23
: I love you too...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你……

lines.en: : Now, just lie right there and don’t move a muscle.
lines.zh: : 现在，就躺在那儿，一根手指都别动。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll be back before you even realize I’m gone.
lines.zh: : 我会在你还没察觉我离开之前就回来的。

lines.en: $ springtime15 = True
$ ami_love += 10
{i}Ami’s affection has increased by 10!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 的好感度提升了 10!{/i}
